Russia Pounds Kyiv Region, Killing 4 and Targeting Power Grid
By HANNA ARHIROVA and BARRY HATTON, Associated Press
September 30, 2026, 5:06 AM [ET]

Russia continued its ongoing missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and surrounding areas, killing four people including a child while focusing strikes on power infrastructure and internet connectivity [a key internet exchange point, per search snippet], according to Ukrainian officials.

Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi stated: "There has been virtually no day since summer when the enemy did not attack energy infrastructure."

Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha commented: "Russia is intensifying its terror: jet-powered drones during the day, ballistic and cruise missiles at night."

A child died and three others were rescued from a destroyed residence in Vyshhorod within the Kyiv region, reported Tymur Tkachenko, the regional military administration leader. Three additional fatalities occurred in the capital itself, with at least four others sustaining injuries.

President Volodymyr Zelenskyy characterized the assault as "a difficult attack" aimed primarily at energy facilities, noting that Russia was pressing Ukraine's air defenses to their limits.

The Ukrainian Air Force spokesman reported Russia launched 3,177 jet-propelled drones through September, compared with 2,850 during August. Officials emphasized the need for additional air defense missiles, particularly Patriot systems, as winter approaches.

Hatton reported from Lisbon, Portugal.
